scenarios.name: Export an unapplied custom ribbon command

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
ribbon customization shows All Commands and an initially empty Part Tools target
2D Sketches has been staged with Large and Text unchecked
the target shows a pending-change marker
the user exports customization to a new XML file
the customization dialog still shows 2D Sketches in the target list
the target still shows a pending-change marker
the exported settings do not contain the staged 2D Sketches command in Part Tools
the user clicks Cancel in the customization dialog
